package main

import (
    "bufio"
    "context"
    "fmt"
    "os"
    "os/exec"
    "sort"
    "strings"
    "sync"
    "time"
)

const (
    projectDir  = "/home/user/project"
    reqFile     = "/home/user/project/requirements.txt"
    outputFile  = "/home/user/response_times.txt"
    apiTimeout  = 10 * time.Second
    pipTimeout  = 60 * time.Second
)

type apiInfo struct {
    name   string
    module string
    fn     string
}

type result struct {
    name     string
    duration time.Duration
}

func runCommand(ctx context.Context, dir, name string, args ...string) error {
    cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, name, args...)
    cmd.Dir = dir
    out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
    if err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "command %s %s failed: %v\noutput: %s\n", name, strings.Join(args, " "), err, string(out))
    }
    return err
}

func installRequirements() {
    fmt.Println("Reading requirements.txt...")
    f, err := os.Open(reqFile)
    if err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "failed to open requirements: %v\n", err)
        return
    }
    defer f.Close()
    scanner := bufio.NewScanner(f)
    for scanner.Scan() {
        line := strings.TrimSpace(scanner.Text())
        if line != "" {
            fmt.Printf("dependency: %s\n", line)
        }
    }
    if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error reading requirements: %v\n", err)
    }

    fmt.Println("Installing requirements via pip...")
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), pipTimeout)
    defer cancel()
    if err := runCommand(ctx, projectDir, "python", "-m", "pip", "install", "-r", reqFile); err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "pip install failed, continuing anyway: %v\n", err)
    }
}

func runTestAPI() {
    fmt.Println("Running test_api.py...")
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
    defer cancel()
    if err := runCommand(ctx, projectDir, "python", "test_api.py"); err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "test_api.py execution had errors: %v\n", err)
    }
}

func callAPI(api apiInfo, ch chan<- result) {
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), apiTimeout)
    defer cancel()

    // Use python to import and invoke the API function, measuring the remote
    // call inside Python as a sanity check. We measure overall wall time here.
    script := fmt.Sprintf(
        "import time; from %s import %s; start=time.time(); %s(); print('elapsed', time.time()-start)",
        api.module, api.fn, api.fn,
    )

    cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "python", "-c", script)
    cmd.Dir = projectDir

    start := time.Now()
    out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
    elapsed := time.Since(start)

    if ctx.Err() == context.DeadlineExceeded {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s timed out after %v\n", api.name, apiTimeout)
    } else if err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s returned error: %v\n%s\n", api.name, err, string(out))
    }

    ch <- result{name: api.name, duration: elapsed}
}

func main() {
    // 1. Install dependencies from requirements.txt using pip.
    installRequirements()

    // 2. Run the existing Python test file.
    runTestAPI()

    // 3. Invoke each API concurrently using goroutines and channels.
    apis := []apiInfo{
        {name: "API1", module: "api.api1", fn: "api1"},
        {name: "API2", module: "api.api2", fn: "api2"},
    }

    ch := make(chan result, len(apis))
    var wg sync.WaitGroup
    for _, a := range apis {
        wg.Add(1)
        go func(a apiInfo) {
            defer wg.Done()
            callAPI(a, ch)
        }(a)
    }

    wg.Wait()
    close(ch)

    var results []result
    for r := range ch {
        results = append(results, r)
    }

    // 4. Write response times to output file.
    sort.Slice(results, func(i, j int) bool { return results[i].name < results[j].name })

    out, err := os.Create(outputFile)
    if err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "failed to create output file: %v\n", err)
        os.Exit(1)
    }
    defer out.Close()

    for _, r := range results {
        fmt.Fprintf(out, "%s,%.6f\n", r.name, r.duration.Seconds())
    }

    fmt.Printf("Response times written to %s\n", outputFile)
}

import (

type apiInfo struct {

    module string
    fn     string
}

type result struct {

    duration time.Duration

func runCommand(ctx context.Context, dir, name string, args ...string) error {
    cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, name, args...)
    cmd.Dir = dir
    out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
    if err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "command %s %s failed: %v\noutput: %s\n", name, strings.Join(args, " "), err, string(out))
    }

}

func installRequirements() {

    f, err := os.Open(reqFile)
    if err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "failed to open requirements: %v\n", err)
        return
    }
    defer f.Close()
    scanner := bufio.NewScanner(f)
    for scanner.Scan() {
        line := strings.TrimSpace(scanner.Text())
        if line != "" {
            fmt.Printf("dependency: %s\n", line)
        }
    }
    if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error reading requirements: %v\n", err)
    }

    }

    if err := runCommand(ctx, projectDir, "python", "test_api.py"); err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "test_api.py execution had errors: %v\n", err)
    }
}

func callAPI(api apiInfo, ch chan<- result) {
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), apiTimeout)
    defer cancel()

    // Use python to import and invoke the API function, measuring the remote
    // call inside Python as a sanity check. We measure overall wall time here.
    script := fmt.Sprintf(
        "import time; from %s import %s; start=time.time(); %s(); print('elapsed', time.time()-start)",

    cmd.Dir = projectDir

    start := time.Now()
    out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
    elapsed := time.Since(start)

    } else if err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s returned error: %v\n%s\n", api.name, err, string(out))
    }

    ch <- result{name: api.name, duration: elapsed}
}

    }

}

package main

import (
    "bufio"
    "context"
    "fmt"
    "os"
    "os/exec"
    "sort"
    "strings"
    "sync"
    "time"
)

const (
    projectDir  = "/home/user/project"
    reqFile     = "/home/user/project/requirements.txt"
    outputFile  = "/home/user/response_times.txt"
    apiTimeout  = 10 * time.Second
    pipTimeout  = 60 * time.Second
)

type apiInfo struct {
    name   string
    module string
    fn     string
}

type result struct {
    name     string
    duration time.Duration
}

func runCommand(ctx context.Context, dir, name string, args ...string) error {
    cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, name, args...)
    cmd.Dir = dir
    out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
    if err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "command %s %s failed: %v\noutput: %s\n", name, strings.Join(args, " "), err, string(out))
    }
    return err
}

func installRequirements() {
    fmt.Println("Reading requirements.txt...")
    f, err := os.Open(reqFile)
    if err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "failed to open requirements: %v\n", err)
        return
    }
    defer f.Close()
    scanner := bufio.NewScanner(f)
    for scanner.Scan() {
        line := strings.TrimSpace(scanner.Text())
        if line != "" {
            fmt.Printf("dependency: %s\n", line)
        }
    }
    if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error reading requirements: %v\n", err)
    }

    fmt.Println("Installing requirements via pip...")
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), pipTimeout)
    defer cancel()
    if err := runCommand(ctx, projectDir, "python", "-m", "pip", "install", "-r", reqFile); err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "pip install failed, continuing anyway: %v\n", err)
    }
}

func runTestAPI() {
    fmt.Println("Running test_api.py...")
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
    defer cancel()
    if err := runCommand(ctx, projectDir, "python", "test_api.py"); err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "test_api.py execution had errors: %v\n", err)
    }
}

func callAPI(api apiInfo, ch chan<- result) {
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), apiTimeout)
    defer cancel()

    // Use python to import and invoke the API function, measuring the remote
    // call inside Python as a sanity check. We measure overall wall time here.
    script := fmt.Sprintf(
        "import time; from %s import %s; start=time.time(); %s(); print('elapsed', time.time()-start)",
        api.module, api.fn, api.fn,
    )

    cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "python", "-c", script)
    cmd.Dir = projectDir

    start := time.Now()
    out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
    elapsed := time.Since(start)

    if ctx.Err() == context.DeadlineExceeded {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s timed out after %v\n", api.name, apiTimeout)
    } else if err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s returned error: %v\n%s\n", api.name, err, string(out))
    }

    ch <- result{name: api.name, duration: elapsed}
}

func main() {
    // 1. Install dependencies from requirements.txt using pip.
    installRequirements()

    // 2. Run the existing Python test file.
    runTestAPI()

    // 3. Invoke each API concurrently using goroutines and channels.
    apis := []apiInfo{
        {name: "API1", module: "api.api1", fn: "api1"},
        {name: "API2", module: "api.api2", fn: "api2"},
    }

    ch := make(chan result, len(apis))
    var wg sync.WaitGroup
    for _, a := range apis {
        wg.Add(1)
        go func(a apiInfo) {
            defer wg.Done()
            callAPI(a, ch)
        }(a)
    }

    wg.Wait()
    close(ch)

    var results []result
    for r := range ch {
        results = append(results, r)
    }

    // 4. Write response times to output file.
    sort.Slice(results, func(i, j int) bool { return results[i].name < results[j].name })

    out, err := os.Create(outputFile)
    if err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "failed to create output file: %v\n", err)
        os.Exit(1)
    }
    defer out.Close()

    for _, r := range results {
        fmt.Fprintf(out, "%s,%.6f\n", r.name, r.duration.Seconds())
    }

    fmt.Printf("Response times written to %s\n", outputFile)
}
```

func runCommand(ctx context.Context, dir, name string, args ...string) error {

    }
}

    script := fmt.Sprintf(

    } else if err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s returned error: %v\n%s\n", api.name, err, string(out))
    }

    ch <- result{name: api.name, duration: elapsed}
}

}

type apiEndpoint struct { name, module, function string }
type apiResult struct { name string; duration time.Duration }

func runCommandOutput(ctx context.Context, dir, name string, args ...string) error {
    cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, name, args...)
    cmd.Dir = dir
    out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
    if err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[concurrency_test] command %s %s failed: %v\noutput: %s\n", name, strings.Join(args, " "), err, string(out))
    }
    return err
}

func installRequirements(t *testing.T) {
    fmt.Println("Reading requirements.txt...")
    f, err := os.Open(requirementsFile)
    if err != nil { t.Logf(...); return }
    defer f.Close()
    scanner := bufio.NewScanner(f)
    for scanner.Scan() { line := strings.TrimSpace(scanner.Text()); if line != "" { fmt.Printf("dependency: %s\n", line) } }
    ...
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), pipInstallTimeout)
    defer cancel()
    fmt.Println("Installing requirements via pip...")
    if err := runCommandOutput(ctx, projectDir, "python", "-m", "pip", "install", "-r", requirementsFile); err != nil {
        t.Logf("pip install failed (continuing): %v", err)
    }
}

func runPythonTests(t *testing.T) {
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
    defer cancel()
    fmt.Println("Running test_api.py...")
    if err := runCommandOutput(ctx, projectDir, "python", "test_api.py"); err != nil {
        t.Logf("test_api.py failed (continuing): %v", err)
    }
}

func callAPITimed(ctx context.Context, endpoint apiEndpoint, ch chan<- apiResult) {
    script := fmt.Sprintf("import time; from %s import %s; start=time.time(); %s(); print(time.time()-start)", endpoint.module, endpoint.function, endpoint.function)
    start := time.Now()
    out, err := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "python", "-c", script).CombinedOutput()
    elapsed := time.Since(start)
    if err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s call failed: %v\n%s\n", endpoint.name, err, string(out))
    }
    ch <- apiResult{name: endpoint.name, duration: elapsed}
}

type apiEndpoint struct { name, module, function string }
type apiResult struct { name string; duration time.Duration }

func runCommandOutput(ctx context.Context, dir, name string, args ...string) error {
    cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, name, args...)
    cmd.Dir = dir
    out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
    if err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[concurrency_test] command %s %s failed: %v\noutput: %s\n", name, strings.Join(args, " "), err, string(out))
    }
    return err
}

func installRequirements(t *testing.T) {
    fmt.Println("Reading requirements.txt...")
    f, err := os.Open(requirementsFile)
    if err != nil { t.Logf(...); return }
    defer f.Close()
    scanner := bufio.NewScanner(f)
    for scanner.Scan() { line := strings.TrimSpace(scanner.Text()); if line != "" { fmt.Printf("dependency: %s\n", line) } }
    ...
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), pipInstallTimeout)
    defer cancel()
    fmt.Println("Installing requirements via pip...")
    if err := runCommandOutput(ctx, projectDir, "python", "-m", "pip", "install", "-r", requirementsFile); err != nil {
        t.Logf("pip install failed (continuing): %v", err)
    }
}

func runPythonTests(t *testing.T) {
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
    defer cancel()
    fmt.Println("Running test_api.py...")
    if err := runCommandOutput(ctx, projectDir, "python", "test_api.py"); err != nil {
        t.Logf("test_api.py failed (continuing): %v", err)
    }
}

func callAPITimed(ctx context.Context, endpoint apiEndpoint, ch chan<- apiResult) {
    script := fmt.Sprintf("import time; from %s import %s; start=time.time(); %s(); print(time.time()-start)", endpoint.module, endpoint.function, endpoint.function)
    start := time.Now()
    out, err := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "python", "-c", script).CombinedOutput()
    elapsed := time.Since(start)
    if err != nil {
        fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s call failed: %v\n%s\n", endpoint.name, err, string(out))
    }
    ch <- apiResult{name: endpoint.name, duration: elapsed}
}

func TestConcurrency(t *testing.T) {
    installRequirements(t)
    runPythonTests(t)

    endpoints := []apiEndpoint{
        {name: "API1", module: "api.api1", function: "api1"},
        {name: "API2", module: "api.api2", function: "api2"},
    }
    results := make(chan apiResult, len(endpoints))
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), apiCallTimeout+5*time.Second)
    defer cancel()
    var wg sync.WaitGroup
    for _, ep := range endpoints {
        ep := ep
        wg.Add(1)
        go func() { defer wg.Done(); callAPITimed(ctx, ep, results) }()
    }
    wg.Wait()
    close(results)

    var list []apiResult
    for r := range results { list = append(list, r) }
    sort.Slice(list, func(i, j int) bool { return list[i].name < list[j].name })

    out, err := os.Create(responseTimesFile)
    if err != nil { t.Fatalf(...) }
    defer out.Close()
    for _, r := range list {
        fmt.Fprintf(out, "%s,%.6f\n", r.name, r.duration.Seconds())
    }
    t.Logf("Wrote %s", responseTimesFile)
}
